description: Briefly poll 1-25 owned world, model, asset-pack, material, material-pack, Image, or audio assets in one bounded request. timeout_ms is optional, defaults to 30000, and must not exceed 60000; omit it to use the default. Uses one optional until_stage and shared timeout, preserves input order, and returns per-asset status, stage, chatUrl, typed failure diagnostics, safe moderationCategories when available, retry guidance, last-activity fields, and an aggregate summary. Terminal successes and failures are preserved even when other assets time out or cannot be read. Use repeated short waits instead of holding a long request.

timeout_ms.description: Optional shared short-wait timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000 and must not exceed 60000; omit it to use the default.

name: wait_for_many
title: Wait For Many
